bio.text: Nicole Lowen represents District 7 in the Hawaii House of Representatives and lives in Kailua-Kona.
She earned a bachelor's degree in history from the University of Pennsylvania in 1994 and a master's degree in urban and regional planning from the University of Hawaii at Manoa.
Her career experience includes work as a legislative researcher and committee clerk with the Hawaii State Legislature and as a legislative liaison with the University of Hawaii Environmental Center.
